notes: No weekday evening Mass on public holidays.

info.adoration: The Adoration Room is on Level 3. Monday to Saturday: 07:00 to 22:00; Sunday: 07:00 to 18:00. Closed on Public Holidays and during the Easter Triduum.
info.confession: Confessions are heard 20 minutes before each weekend Mass in the Confessional Box at the back of the Main Church.
devotions: Rosary: Monday to Friday at 19:00, before the evening Mass.
Holy Hour: first Thursday of the month at 20:15 in the Main Church.
Divine Mercy: second Saturday of the month at 15:00 in the Main Church.
info.office_hours: Secretariat: Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00; Sat 09:00–13:00; 2nd & last Sun 09:00–12:00. Catechetical Office: Tue & Wed 09:00–14:00; Sat 09:00–13:00, 14:00–17:00. Columbarium Office: Mon 14:00–16:00; Tue–Fri 09:00–16:00.
good_to_know: Church opening hours: Mon–Sat 06:00–22:00; Sun 06:00–18:00; Public Holidays on weekdays 07:00–13:00.
Children Liturgy: every Sunday at the 11:30 Mass.
Columbarium Prayers & Mass Intentions: last Sunday of the month, prayers at the columbarium after the 11:30 Mass.

events.title: Catholic Divorce Support Group (CDSG): Divorce Separation and Annulment Symposium
events.text: Part 1 on 5 October 2026, Monday; Part 2 on 19 October 2026, Monday. Online via Zoom from 20:00 to 22:00. Register at http://bit.ly/DSAOct26.

events.title: The Search 2026: 2nd Run
events.text: Video-based series exploring fundamental questions about God, Faith and Church. Small groups watch and discuss. Every Monday from 19 October to 30 November 2026, online via Zoom at 20:00. Registration closing date: 5 October 2026. Register at https://bit.ly/search-sac2026-2nd-run. Enquiries: sac.ncc

events.title: Catholic Leadership Centre: Inner Healing Retreat
events.text: Stay-in retreat for those carrying inner wounds from broken relationships caused by divorce in the family. Teaching, prayer, personal reflection before the Blessed Sacrament, and a one-to-one session with a spiritual director. Dates: 24 to 25 October 2026. Venue: Punggol Retreat Centre, Singapore. F

events.title: All Saints’ Day Family Celebration
events.text: Come together to honour and celebrate the life of our Saints. Discover our "Saints Alive" exhibition and dress your children in their favourite Saints. Enjoy family games and bring a dish to share with fellow families. Community Celebration at 14:00, Mass at 16:30. Venue: St Joachim’s Hall (Level 4)
